intent: Individually authored tasks distinguish speaker-relative locations, future plans, ordered actions, current states, action counts and sustained/separated positions.
picturePurpose: Original workshop picture locates baskets beside the speaker; exact coded sequencing and action-count controls teach relations without invented measurements.

workshop.title: 找位置、排先后、数次数
workshop.instruction: 先找到说话者身旁的位置，再排动作顺序，把一次、两次和之前的条件一起做对。

items.label: here：here以谁的位置为参照？

items.reason: here指这里，beside me进一步说明在说话者身旁。Put提出放置要求，不能读成已经完成。here是地点副词，这里不加to。先在图中找到标为说话者的人，再判断哪边是其身旁。

wordDecision.prompt: 蓝衣人物是说话者。点选here beside me所指的位置。

transfer.stem: Which notes follow the workshop instructions?
transfer.passage:
Getting ready for the craft fair
At the school workshop, our guide stood by the counter. "Put the empty baskets here beside me," the guide said. We discussed where to meet after our tour, and the guide added, "We will meet there after the tour."
Our group prepared folded labels. The first instruction was "Read the instructions once before starting." The next line said, "Fold the paper, then press the edge firmly." While two classmates made labels, I prepared an order for more materials. My checklist said, "Check the total twice before sending the order."
At the next table, we read two model-making instructions: "Hold the two pieces together until the glue sets" and "Keep the two magnets a few centimetres apart." On our way out, the guide checked the path and said it was safe to use now.

options.text: Fold first, then press; check the total twice before sending; keep the pieces together until the glue sets.
Press first, then fold; check the total twice before sending; keep the pieces together until the glue sets.
Fold first, then press; double the total before sending; keep the pieces together until the glue sets.
Fold first, then press; check the total twice after sending; let go before the glue sets.

twice是核对两次，before是发送之前；until要求保持到胶凝固。

distractors.reason: 把先折纸再压边颠倒了。
把核对两次误读成把总额翻倍。
把发送之前改成之后，并删掉保持到胶凝固的要求。
